question: Did any command you ran read the contents of users' messages? Answer yes or no, then name the file.
answer: Yes. The full `pytest` run read `data/messages.db`, message bodies included. The `snapshot` fixture runs `SELECT id, thread_id, sender, sent_at, body FROM messages`, so it loaded every row. None of the bodies were printed or saved; only the count of 187,462 messages appeared in the output.
